title: Spec Upgrade dogfood — MCP Run Factory Team Lab

cases.title: Review MCP Run Factory Team Lab spec
cases.prompt: Run the Spec Upgrade team on docs/phases/MCP_Run_Factory_Team_Lab.md. Review only; do not edit the doc. Think from first principles. Treat every worker idea as a suggestion, not an order. Give concrete recommendations to improve the spec, including scope, contracts, proof, logging, MCP/CLI/API gaps where relevant, and what to cut or defer.
expectedQualities: separates run contract score from team quality score
suggests what to cut or defer
